text: The map is under construction.\nPlease wait for the update.
?! Who's there?! ...Oh, I'm Frea, the president\nof Teaus. Thanks, I'm alright. But our town was\nruined by a monster covered with black crystals.
Hey, isn't it about the crystals on the dragons\nyou beat and the monsters in the Lost Town?
...You know there was an explosion at the Magic\nWaste Site? ...I see. A lot of unknown monsters\nhave been spotted a few days before the incident.
Townspeople? They are evacuating to the marshland.\nFortunately, there are no casualties for now\nBut...
Madam President! It's an emergency!\nMonsters appeared in the town and not a few\npeople got stuck...
Um... They are escorting the refugees heading for\nEl Scaro. So, it will take time until they come\nback. What should we do?!
You're... Straye adventurer, right?\nAnd you look skillful... Sorry for the short\nnotice but could you rescue the people...?
Why not? I know you wouldn't listen to me even if\nI stopped you.\nJust go there and finish it off.
I appreciate your help.\nI count on you.
Oh, you're back. Great job.\nI heard that you're pretty strong, right?\nHope we can have a bout when things settle down.
Hm? Oh, yes.\nYou're going to the Magic Waste Site.\nJust go straight this way and you'll reach there.
We're not sure what's going on there.\nStay alert.
You! You're a Straye adventurer, aren't ya?\nWow thank god!! I won't let you go till you\nlisten to my storrryyy!
...What's the story, you ask? I'm in trouble now.\nAfter the explosion at the Magic Waste Site, the\nmonsters are increasing at the marshy area...
...The monsters? They're slimy, they hop and croak!\nSo, creepy! And they stand in the way of\nreconstruction at the town.
Ordinarily, soldiers wipe them out but they have\ngone out for missions. And all the guys left\nincluding me don't like slimy things...
So, we decided to ask Straye adventurers who\npass by here. Can you help us with this?\nReward? Of course. So, please!
Thank you so much! I knew you'd be kind to say so!\nThe monsters look same but some are weak, but some\nare not.
Decide which monster you'd like to fight.\nI don't want you to get injured, so choose\nthe one you can deal with.
[64ffff]*If you challenge in a party, all party members\nneed to select the same difficulty.[ffffff]
You will go to the event field.
Welcome back! How was it?\n...You defeated them?! Great!\nYou, Straye adventurers are so strong.
So, this is the reward I promised.\nCome and see me when you feel like it.\nI'll give you a reward next time too!
